head: 056341c30d15157d941566c90193c9d384b51d45
changes: Native CLI uses real NativeExportHandle and NativeStubHandle, no plaintext backend listener or Rust engine dependency in native-only feature.
Trusted config namespace is validated before helper actions; exact DeviceKey, BusID and actual TLS peer ACL checked before helper stub open.
Published metadata is explicitly preexport registration snapshot, not live configuration/IF state.
Helper prepare/open/commit calls are not dropped midway on cooperative stop; every known stub closes before export cleanup.
IMPORT success is written and flushed before any raw kernel relay bytes.
16 owned connection permits cover handshake, relay and actual stub cleanup; accepted connections and per-export watcher tasks are joined, never detached or aborted during helper transactions.
Bounded inherited EventOutput handles signal and blocked stdout; Native controls support snapshot/shutdown only.
Added four private in-memory/control tests, plus Native namespace cases in existing namespace test.

validation.test_scope: Memory I/O/control branches only; no claim of helper/kernel/driver or physical validation.

limits: Actual full-workspace/Native-only compilation is root-owned and pending for these source bytes.
Native helper can retain uncertainty and unresolved records; no generic hotplug or cross-configuration restoration guarantee.
Kernel hardblocking can delay cooperative cleanup; no fake abort or fixed total cleanup assertion.
Dedicated broker UID is a trust domain, not per-executable isolation.
